# Ceramic Design System agent rules

1. Run `npm run ceramic -- manifest --json` before generating UI.
2. Run `npm run ceramic -- search <intent> --json`, then inspect the selected component or template.
3. Prefer `@utopia-studio-design/design-system` exports over raw shadcn/ui source.
4. Components consume semantic tokens only. The active theme is `utopia-default`.
5. Request semantic motion only; inspect `npm run ceramic -- motion ceremonial --json` before choosing an application runtime adapter.
6. Read `npm run ceramic -- docs arabic-friendly --dense` before Arabic or RTL work.
7. Never invent component props, import paths, tokens, Arabic product copy, or left/right-only APIs.
8. Validate with `npm run ceramic:doctor` before handoff.

## Repo Workflow

Before committing skill or script changes, run the quality loop:

1. `npm run validate` — marketplace integrity (packed skills resolve, frontmatter valid, no generated drift)
2. `node --test scripts/trigger-test.test.mjs scripts/skill-behavior.test.mjs` — helper tests
3. `npm run lint` — ruff over Python helpers (config: `ruff.toml`)
4. `python3 scripts/skill_gate.py check --base origin/main` — skill quality gate (static checks, listing budget, routing evidence)

Edit sources under `skills/<module>/` only; `plugins/`, `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`, and doc counts are generated by `./build-packs.sh`. After changing a packed skill, rebuild then re-run validate. New skills, and any changed name or description, need a routing report: `npm run eval:skill -- <skill>`. Full flow: [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md).
